== Summary ==
Bruce Umene at DecipherCon 1999. Crop of [[:File:Bruce Umene DecipherCon 1999.jpg]]. Photo: Decipher. See [[Bruce Umene]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].

Identification: Decipher fri30 caption "Tournaments Coordinator Bruce Umene does the macarena while Aron Eisenberg signs." The standing man in the black shirt with his arm out is Umene.
